jobs.title: Junior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Egybell is hiring a Junior Financial Analyst for a well-known company located in 5th Settlement

Requirements:

Assist in analysing financial data and preparing reports to support decision-making processes.
Manage and maintain data sheets, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
Utilize Power BI for data visualization and reporting purposes.
Work with ERP systems (SAP, ARIBA and YARDI) to extract, update, and validate financial information.
Perform data queries and generate insights to identify trends and discrepancies.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements related to data handling.
Collaborate with team members to improve data management and reporting processes.

Qualifications:

1 year of experience in Real Estate sector or similar
Excellent in Microsoft Excel, power point and Power PI.
Strong understanding of setting up and organizing database and spread sheets.
Excellent command of English.
